[USER] User is interested in making grilled chicken for a summer barbecue.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided a step-by-step guide to make perfectly grilled chicken.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] The assistant listed ingredients for grilled chicken: 4-6 boneless, skinless chicken breasts, 1/4 cup olive oil, 1/4 cup lemon juice, 2 cloves garlic (minced), 2 teaspoons dried oregano, 1 teaspoon salt, 1/2 teaspoon black pepper.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided instructions for grilling chicken, including preheating the grill to medium-high heat (around 400-450°F), marinating the chicken for 20-30 minutes, cooking for 6-7 minutes per side, and ensuring the internal temperature reaches at least 165°F.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant advised letting the chicken rest for 5-10 minutes before serving to allow juices to redistribute.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant suggested slicing the chicken breasts into pieces and serving with favorite sides.  
[USER] User expressed that the instructions sounded simple enough.  
[USER] User inquired about making grilled chicken without a grill.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant confirmed that grilled chicken can be made using a grill pan or a cast-iron skillet.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] The assistant repeated the ingredients for grilled chicken.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided instructions for cooking chicken in a grill pan or cast-iron skillet, including heating the pan over medium-high heat and cooking for 6-7 minutes per side.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant reiterated the importance of checking the internal temperature of the chicken and letting it rest before serving.  
[USER] User stated they would try making grilled chicken using a grill pan since they do not have a grill.
